title: Quantum Space Memory v2: 4-Tier WOW QPU Campaign on IBM Heron r2
description: 4-tier experimental campaign testing Active Quantum Zeno dynamics across increasing qubit counts (1, 2, 3, 5 qubits) on 156-qubit IBM Heron r2 (ibm_marrakesh). Tiers B0-B2 are preregistered with explicit pass/fail gates; B3 is exploratory. Builds on quantum-active-space-memory v1.3.3 (N=20, ΔF=+97.35pp, PREREG PASSED). All tiers include in-job readout calibration. Key expected results: B0 ΔF≈97pp, B1 ΔF_parity≈23pp, B2 ΔF_GHZ≈24pp, B3 exploratory 5-qubit scaling.
